# Offline media fixture

`film.webm` is a 128×96, approximately two-second VP8/Vorbis clip generated by
Simulation's S020b direct sandbox fixture (`tests/test_library_media.py`). Its
frames and two-tone audio are procedural test data created for this project,
not model output or an experimental archive. No personal material is included.

The original source is the committed fixture program in Simulation. FFmpeg
7.1.5 encoded the bytes; encoder versions can change byte identity, so tests
check format/behaviour rather than claim identical encoding across versions.
This tiny file lets Window independently test recognition without importing
Simulation code or launching any converter/model. Synthetic WAV is generated
in memory by Window's test code. Never modify the historical run fixtures.
